## v0.12.0

### Features

- **Editor search:** Find (`Ctrl/Cmd+F`), find and replace (`Ctrl/Cmd+H`), find next/previous (`F3` / `Shift+F3`), go to line (`Ctrl/Cmd+G`), and select next occurrence (`Ctrl/Cmd+D`). Tab and `Shift+Tab` indent and outdent the selection. (`a0c6682`)
- **Tab shortcuts:** Reopen the last closed tab (`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+T`) and jump to tabs with `Alt+1`…`Alt+8`, or to the last tab with `Alt+9`. (`a0c6682`)
- **Terminal and file shortcuts:** New Terminal (`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+\``) and Open Folder (`Ctrl/Cmd+O`). Shortcuts now have a dedicated File group. (`a0c6682`)
- **Shortcuts page:** Simplified layout with a refreshed browser and search. (`a0c6682`, `edf5f1b`)
- **Themes:** Simplified theme picker layout. (`edf5f1b`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.11.0...v0.12.0
